instrument_name: DES - Unemployment Insurance Operating Fund (UIOF) page + Unemployment-Employer announcements
article_or_section: Key Provisions; calculation example; Filing; FUTA Reporting Notes
figure_or_rule_carried: From 2027-01-01, in each quarter of CY2027 experience-rated employers (not new or reimbursable) pay 3.15% of UI tax liability into the UIOF and their UI liability is reduced by 3.15% (total due unchanged: example $8,000 x 1.78% = $142.40; UIOF $4.49; UI contribution $137.91). Paper UIT-0018F Section B, TWS and bulk (Azure/File Transfer) files carry a new UIOF line. 2027 rate notices mailed 2026-12-31. Agency confirmation of US-AZR3-004.

instrument_name: VT Department of Taxes - Withholding for Employers page
article_or_section: Remote workers; Payment Frequency; Quarterly/Annual Reconciliation; How to File
figure_or_rule_carried: W-4VT requested in addition to federal W-4. Out-of-state employers need not withhold VT tax until the employee has worked from a VT location for 30 days. instrument_name: Pittsburgh City Code Chapter 626, Paid Sick Days Act (as amended by Ord. No. 11-2025, effective 2026-01-01) - official City PDF
authority: City of Pittsburgh (Office of Equal Protection, Law Department)
figure_or_rule_carried: Covers employers with 1+ employees in the City (not US/PA government). Accrual 1 hour per 30 hours worked in Pittsburgh for all employers; cap per calendar year and on access: 72 hours (15+ employees) / 48 hours (<15 employees), unless employer sets higher. FLSA-exempt staff assumed 40 h/week. Use from the 90th calendar day of employment. Carryover required unless the employer front-loads 72 h (15+) / 48 h (<15) at the start of each year. No payout at separation; reinstatement on rehire within 6 months. Paid at the same base rate and benefits, never below PA minimum wage (43 P.S. 333.104(a)); no pay for lost tips/commissions. Guidelines v4.1 (rev. 12/9/25, eff. 1/1/26) also published (20 pp., not transcribed).
